name: Troubleshoot and resolve database errors and connection issues
description: Users asked to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve specific runtime errors, connection failures, or configuration bugs in database systems and related software services. The requests often involved analyzing provided error messages, log files, or code snippets to identify causes such as network issues, permission denials, syntax mismatches, or invalid data types.
